gloss: to remove; to dismantle; to take down

definitions.gloss: to remove; to dismantle; to take down; to clear away
definitions.explanation: To remove something that was installed, set up, or placed somewhere. Used for structures, equipment, barriers, and other fixed or semi-permanent items.

examples.japanese: ⟦{看板|かんばん}→看板：00166_kanban⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{撤去|てっきょ}する。
⟦{違法|いほう}→違法：09687_ihou⟧⟦{駐輪|ちゅうりん}→駐輪：15100_chuurin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{自転車|じてんしゃ}→自転車：00633_jitensha⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{撤去|てっきょ}された。
examples.english: The illegally parked bicycles were removed.

examples.japanese: ⟦{工事|こうじ}→工事：00244_kouji⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{終|お}わった→終わる：00567_owaru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{足場|あしば}→足場：06518_ashiba⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{撤去|てっきょ}する⟦{作業|さぎょう}→作業：02775_sagyou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{始|はじ}まった→始まる：00841_hajimaru⟧。
examples.english: Since the construction is finished, work to remove the scaffolding has begun.

notes:
Compound of {撤|てつ} (withdraw) + {去|きょ} (remove). Used for removing installed or placed structures, equipment, and objects. More formal than ⟦{取|と}り{除|のぞ}く→取り除く：04222_torinozoku⟧ and implies removing something that was deliberately set up.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{看板|かんばん}→看板：00166_kanban⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{撤去|てっきょ}する: to remove a sign
- ⟦{足場|あしば}→足場：06518_ashiba⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{撤去|てっきょ}する: to remove scaffolding
- ⟦{障害物|しょうがいぶつ}→障害物：15606_shougaibutsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{撤去|てっきょ}する: to clear obstacles
- ⟦{強制|きょうせい}→強制：12500_kyousei⟧⟦{撤去|てっきょ}→撤去：14729_tekkyo⟧: forced removal
- ⟦{撤去|てっきょ}→撤去：14729_tekkyo⟧⟦{費用|ひよう}→費用：03588_hiyou⟧: removal costs

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{除去|じょきょ}する→除去する：22368_jokyosuru⟧: to remove (more general; stains, substances, threats)
- ⟦{撤収|てっしゅう}→撤収：12922_tesshuu⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to withdraw, to pull out (troops, equipment from a location)
- ⟦{解体|かいたい}→解体：06223_kaitai⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to demolish (breaking apart a structure entirely)
